subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort

756720101.text: What's this frisky little Asha doing here? And— Huh? Bennett?

756720104.text: Back at the resort for a vacation, Bennett?

756720105.text: #Uh-huh. {NICKNAME} might recall that I wrote you two a letter to let you know that...

756720106.text: A few months ago, I finally saved up enough money from all my well-paying commissions...

756720107.text: And I finally managed to invite my dads and friends to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort for a proper getaway.

756720108.text: My dads were really pleased to see that my streak of bad luck has almost fully ended at Natlan!

756720109.text: Oh, you definitely have to share good news like this with everyone, Bennett!

756720112.text: Aw, if only we met you two last week. We could all have had a meal together or something.

756720113.text: Hmm, looks like that meal's got to wait till you two come over to Mondstadt again. When you come, we'll find somewhere super safe and have a "Safe Adventuring Cave Dinner" together.

756720114.text: Hold up, Bennett — are you saying that your dads and friends are gone and you're here at the resort by yourself now?

756720115.text: Yeah. My dads were actually having a really good time here when they received news that Miss Diona at Cat's Tail Tavern would be away on a business trip for quite some time...

756720116.text: So, rather than extend their vacation, they decided to return to Mondstadt as originally planned. That way, they'll be able to get in a few more of Miss Diona's special drinks before she goes on her trip.

756720117.text: But don't you worry, I'm not stranded here because of a delay or lost boat ticket or anything. I'm staying to help out a few friends.

756720118.text: We were fishing by the sea when we ran into a few Ashas, known as "colorists," that appeared to be in some kind of tricky situation.

756720119.text: Based on my experience from before, I guessed they were looking for some extraordinary treasure...

756720120.text: Hmm. Since these Ashas are known as colorists, the treasure they were looking for must be...
